name: ai-sdlc
description: AI-Native SDLC plugin for Codex CLI — auto-detects current SDLC stage from workspace artifacts (intent.md → spec.md → plan.md → diff → PR → incident) and drives the full Anthropic playbook (Plan/Design/Build/Test/Deploy/Maintain) without requiring the user to explicitly inject context. Every user message is triaged first: requirements/issues flow into the SDLC pipeline, supplementary info merges into the current cycle's artifacts, and one-off side tasks queue up (.sdlc/quick-tasks.json + quick_task MCP tool) until the cycle completes — never mixed into cycle artifacts. Natural language is the command surface (SessionStart injects an intent-to-tool map); the 18 prompts/ playbooks auto-register into the user prompts dir for the official /prompts:<name> form; a capability-aware cross-platform script guard, zero-action first-use bootstrap, turn-end notifications, and the cycle-archived .sdlc/ workspace (never committed) are built in. Zero dependencies, offline-friendly. Recent: v0.13.11 plan-acceptance channel and lifecycle memory round (quote-aware bash gate: pipes/redirects/substitutions inside quoted search patterns are literal text and no longer falsely blocked; per-turn lifecycle status strip plus awaiting-acceptance reminder keep the agent oriented after context compaction; user says "accept" is detected and routed to accept_plan, with a controlled CLI fallback (sdlc.sh accept / accept-plan.mjs) when MCP tools are not exposed — same lock, same semantics, audited event); v0.13.12 sandbox authorization + controlled Playwright setup round (three-layer Codex sandbox cooperation: pre-flight warning before network/port commands, denial evidence in PostToolUse — sandbox-denied tests no longer count as test failures, next-turn authorization reminder; controlled Playwright environment protocol: setup-playwright.mjs --check read-only probe whitelisted in plan mode, --install full|chrome|skip requires explicit --yes user consent, local-Chrome channel needs zero browser download); v0.13.13 approval-wait notification round (Codex approval prompts "1. Yes, proceed (y) / 2. No (esc)" pause the task mid-turn with no Stop event — network/port commands now trigger an alert-class desktop notification to bring the user back to the terminal, with a 120s presence-window dedupe refreshed on command completion; SDLC_NOTIFY_APPROVAL=off disables the class). Full version history and design decisions: docs/changes/CHANGELOG.md in the plugin.

interface.longDescription: ai-sdlc 把 Anthropic 公开的《AI-Native SDLC playbook》翻译成可执行的 Codex 插件。核心设计：每个 SDLC 阶段以一个工作区工件结束（intent.md → spec.md → plan.md → diff+tests → PR with review → incident→intent.md），插件通过 6 个 Codex 原生生命周期 hook 自动检测当前工件状态、推进阶段、按需注入对应规则/技能/模板，**用户无需显式 @ 插件或手动 slash 命令即可走完整套流程**。工件存于 .sdlc/ 工作区（任务推进的中间产物，不进版本控制，周期/任务结束归档到 .sdlc/archive/）；首次使用的项目由插件自动监测并初始化（state 引导 + .gitignore 托管块）。SessionStart 注入资源索引与当前阶段判定（~1KB）；UserPromptSubmit 按阶段注入规则摘要 + 反模式警告 + 缺失工件提示；PreToolUse 守护受保护路径与产物完整性（修复任务中禁止改测试、无变更工单禁止改迁移、工作区外新建工件提醒落位）；PostToolUse 监听工件文件创建/修改，自动推进阶段状态机；Stop 在结束前提示下一阶段入口；SessionEnd 归档会话快照（工件永不删除）。工件生命周期：周期结束归档轮转到 .sdlc/archive/，多会话/多任务经作用域路由+会话亲和+任务隔离区三层隔离。v0.6.0：intent.md 的 Open questions 交互门禁 + MCP 会话上下文隔离。v0.7.0：测试门禁 + 修复循环中断（retry/new-intent/manual/escalate 四决策）。v0.8.0：frontend-e2e 能力技能（Playwright 前端 E2E）+ 6 个阶段技能实体交付。v0.9.0：frontend-e2e 反检测阶梯 + 原子写/键归一化/行长护栏等安全加固。v0.10.0：工件工作区化（不进版本控制，归档即审计）+ 首次使用自动初始化 + 单一事实源三件套（defaultState/isEngaged/ARTIFACT_CANDIDATES）。v0.11.0：回合结束通知（Stop hook：任务完成或需用户决策/回答时系统弹窗+声音——macOS osascript / Windows PowerShell toast / Linux notify-send；SDLC_NOTIFY_* 配置，防噪阈值长任务必达快答不扰）。v0.12.0：输入分流（Input Triage）——每条用户输入先三分类：需求/ISSUE 统一走 SDLC 流程；补充信息融入当前周期工件；临时任务不走流程——周期进行中登记 quick-tasks 队列（MCP quick_task 工具，待周期走完后统一处理，二者不混淆），无周期则直接处理；SessionStart 注入分流协议、每回合轻量提醒、Stop 防遗忘提醒。v0.13.0 命令体系迁移：官方 CLI 不支持自定义 slash 命令——用户入口统一为自然语言（SessionStart 注入「意图→工具映射表」：临时任务/任务/周期/循环决策等意图直接映射到 quick_task / task_* / new_cycle / loop_resolve 等 MCP 工具），18 份 prompts/ 操作手册可按需读取，也可经注册后用官方 /prompts:<name> 调用；MCP 首次调用置位 sdlc_engaged（保留显式参与语义）。v0.13.1 注册跨平台化：注册通道从单一 bash 脚本升级为三选一——MCP register_prompts 工具（Node fs 单一事实源，说「注册操作手册」即完成，三平台一致，推荐）/ install-prompts.sh（macOS/Linux）/ 新增 install-prompts.ps1（Windows）；SessionStart 自检注册状态（未注册注入一行跨平台指引）并补注入完整意图→工具映射表。v0.13.2 hook 层环境自检与零操作：SessionStart 运行时探测真实 shell 能力（POSIX bash/WSL、PowerShell/pwsh）并注入环境画像（本机不可用的脚本形态直接告知勿调用）；手册自动注册/刷新（ensurePromptsRegistered，升版自愈；显式卸载写 opt-out 标记不再自动恢复；SDLC_PROMPTS_AUTO=off 总关）；PreToolUse 新增能力感知跨平台脚本护栏——拦截「注定失败」的脚本调用（Windows 无 bash 跑 .sh、无 pwsh 的 macOS/Linux 跑 .ps1）并给出精确替代（ps1/sh 孪生脚本或 MCP 免 shell 通道），装了 Git Bash/WSL/pwsh 的环境照常放行不误伤。配套 6 个阶段 SKILL、18 份操作手册、1 个 MCP 编排器（23 工具）、6 份工件模板、闭环节奏配置（bands.yaml）、生产门禁模板（production-gate.sh）。
